lastCompletedStory.title: Define shared auto-merge prerequisite-notice constant and print it from cam init

nextStoryContext: US-003 needs to import AUTOMERGE_NOTICE from src/logging/notices.ts and print it from cam config (config.ts) so that operators running the config wizard also see the GitHub prerequisite notice. The constant is already defined and tested; US-003 only needs to add the import and the unconditional printAutomergeNotice() call at config completion.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only defines a plain TypeScript string constant and a print helper. No external library exercised.
